name: music-skill
description: Write original instrumental music as editable notes, played on licensed sampled instruments, mixed and mastered. No audio-generation model.

plugins.name: music-skill
plugins.description: Write original instrumental music as editable notes: the agent composes and arranges every note, and the skill checks the score, plays it on licensed sampled instruments (pianos, guitars, basses, drums, a full orchestra, saxophones, organ and world instruments), built-in synthesizers or Surge XT presets with player-like timing and dynamics, mixes it through buses and generated reverbs, and masters it with MIDI, stems and an MP3. No audio-generation model is involved.
